description: This file contains the implementation of the ISC_SQLBrowser module for the SmartClient framework, including class definitions, widget initializations, and data source configurations related to SQL database browsing and SQL editing functionalities.

classes.name: SQLEditor
classes.description: A class representing a SQL editor widget with input form and execution capabilities.

classes.name: SQLTableBrowser
classes.description: A class for browsing SQL tables with grid and filtering features.

classes.name: DBPane
classes.description: A tabbed pane for database operations, including schema browsing and table viewing.

classes.name: DBSchema
classes.description: A data source representing database schema information.

classes.name: DBSchemaTree
classes.description: A tree grid displaying database schema details.

classes.name: DataSourceStore
classes.description: A data source managing SQL data sources and operations.

classes.name: DBList
classes.description: A list grid showing available database instances.

classes.name: DBCompactList
classes.description: A form for selecting and managing database connections.

classes.name: DBListDS
classes.description: A data source providing list of database instances with status and version info.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the widget components for various classes such as SQLEditor, SQLTableBrowser, etc.

methods.name: execSQL
methods.description: Executes the SQL query entered in the SQL input form.

methods.name: dsLoaded
methods.description: Handles the data source loading callback.

methods.name: showDBPane
methods.description: Displays the database pane with schema and table options.

methods.name: showTablePane
methods.description: Displays the table browser for a selected table.

methods.name: escapeForId
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used as an ID by replacing '/' and '.' characters.
